3967-7084-8347.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4131-5660-6769-6798.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4131-5660-6769-6798.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2829-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2829-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2

647-3259-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
647-3259-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

7546-7683-7752.notablePrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 or higher.
7546-7683-7752.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Maestro's Gift's storm ability triggers, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target Prismari.
Resolve the first copy of Maestro's Gift targeting Prismari, creating a token copy of Prismari with haste.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining copy of Maestro's Gift that targets Prismari.
Resolve the final copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Maestro's Gift will have a storm ability for each Prismari you control, and each storm ability will trigger.
Resolve the first storm trigger, copying Maestro's Gift for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target Prismari.
Repeat step 3 for each copy created in step 8.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 for each remaining storm trigger from step 7.
Repeat from step 5 as mana allows.
7546-7683-7752.notes: The listed mana cost is a suggested cost - you may use less mana, but you'll get less tokens. You can also compensate for less mana by having a higher storm count. It isn't required for each Maestro's Gift to copy Prismari, but doing so will net you more storm triggers the next iteration. On the last iteration, you can target whatever creature(s) you desire.

413-2744--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat

Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.

When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.

49-2034-4871-6967-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Coercive Recruiter.
When Coercive Recruiter enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-5143-6410.description:

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.

1251-2034-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2060-2577-5147-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2577-5147-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.

Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

Create a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Corridor Monitor copy.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

372-961-2556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-2556.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Prosperous Innkeeper.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6114.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-3490-6114.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Skyknight Squire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

222-4050-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Infested Thrinax, adding {R}.
When Infested Thrinax dies, its delayed ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saproling tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Infested Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Infested Thrinax enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Infested Thrinax triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
You may repeat steps 12 and 13 once for another nontoken creature you control, if desired.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saproling tokens, adding {1}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 12.

When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.

When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.

224-539-3652-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-3652-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.

2634-4821-4910.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.

Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Activate Alchemist's Refuge's second ability by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.

Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.

Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1760-4364-4598.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.

Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

Thornbite Staff and Presence of Gond attached to the same creature.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior token, adding {C}{C}.

During any opponent's turn, activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
